# D8_CAN_RESULTS: re-runs on the D8 print-rule candidates beside the stored results (W-D8SPEC; auto-generated by canres3.py)

Set families: BASE = stored engine bars (per-order records, tape flag); _CAN = ms merge + tape flag; _CANQ = contract-level prints + last-vs-bid/ask; _CANR = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask with FIRST-record stamp (look-ahead, reference only); _CANC = run merge, causal close (next different print); _CANG = run merge with 1 s gap cap, causal close. All: book alone on the all-new base, account layers on, 1 lot, 42 months (L6M 2026-05..10, L3M 2026-08..10, years 2023-25). Verdict vs BASE: HOLDS = every window within 15% on mean and ulcer; CHANGES = some window 15-30% worse; BREAKS = any window mean <= 0 or more than 30% worse on mean or ulcer.
